name: The Trade Desk
tagline: Global leader in programmatic advertising technology powered by AI
hero_kpi_rationale: Révenu comme KPI maître secteur pour mesurer la croissance de la plateforme et la part de marché dans l'écosystème publicitaire numérique mondial

kpis.description_fr: Volume pub transité plateforme TTD (avant take-rate ~20%). Métrique scale dominant DSP indépendant. Croissance soutenue CTV.
kpis.description_en: Total ad spend transacted on TTD platform (before ~20% take rate). Dominant independent DSP scale metric. Sustained CTV growth.

kpis.description_fr: Mix CTV (Connected TV) sur revenu. Plus fort vertical croissance, drive le shift TV linéaire vers streaming. Leader DSP CTV.
kpis.description_en: CTV (Connected TV) revenue mix. Strongest growth vertical, drives linear TV to streaming shift. DSP CTV leader.

kpis.description_fr: Marge EBITDA ajustée. Très élevée (modèle plateforme), stable malgré investissements Kokai + UID2. Cible 40%+ structurelle.
kpis.description_en: Adj EBITDA margin. Very high (platform model), stable despite Kokai + UID2 investments. Structural 40%+ target.

kpis.description_fr: Taux rétention clients agences/brands (>12 mois). Exceptionnel 9 années consécutives. Switching costs élevés.
kpis.description_en: Customer retention (agencies/brands, >12 mo). Exceptional 9 consecutive years. High switching costs.

kpis.description_fr: Mix CA hors US. Croissance progressive Europe + APAC, runway long restant (US = 88% encore). Cible 30%+ moyen terme, levier diversification géographique structurelle.
kpis.description_en: Non-US revenue mix. Gradual EU + APAC growth, long runway remaining (US still 88%). 30%+ medium-term target, structural geographic diversification lever.

company_description: The Trade Desk, Inc. operates as a technology company in the United States and internationally. The company creates, manages, and optimizes digital advertising campaigns across ad formats, channels and devices, including CTV and other video, display, audio, and native, on a multitude of devices, such televisions, streaming devices, mobile devices, computers and digital-out-of-home devices. It provides data and other value-added services. It serves advertising agencies, advertisers, and other service providers for agencies or advertisers. The Trade Desk, Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Ventura, California.
